logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water coefficients of the complexes were determined as previously reported65 using the shake-flask method. Buffered distilled water (100 mL, phosphate buffer [PO43–] = 10 mM, [NaCl] = 0.15 M, pH 7.4) and n-octanol (100 mL) were shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. Each complex (ca. 1 mg) was mixed in the aqueous and organic phase (5 mL each), respectively, for 10 min. The resultant emulsion was centrifuged to separate the phases. The concentrations of the compounds in each phase were determined by UV/Vis spectroscopy; log D7.4 is defined as log {[compound(organic)]/[compound(aqueous)]}.
